subject: Problems accessing data on https from shinyapps.io

messages.author: a2d348050b707474
messages.subject: Problems accessing data on https from shinyapps.io
parts:
I recently built a simple shiny app that calls a web service to return XML data, parse through it (using the XML library) and provide a number of visualization options. The app worked great locally and when deployed on Shinyapps.io, but when the data were moved to https (from http), I had to use the RCurl library, and now my app only works locally, but not on Shinyapps.io. 

Does anyone have suggestions to get around this?
